notes: Mayotte's first and only data center (France TV Info March 2025 calls it 'l'unique data center de Mayotte'); opened October 2022 in Mamoudzou near the Centre Hospitalier de Mayotte. Tier III design, ~80 racks (196-bay design capacity and 2 x (3 x 200) kVA ~1.2 MW IT power per engineering consultant CCE Ingenierie), 215 m2 white space, PUE 1.5 target. ~EUR 10M investment supported by Banque des Territoires/Caisse des Depots (EUR 1.35M), Conseil departemental (EUR 0.5M), FEDER (EUR 1.7M), AFD and Credit Agricole loan. ~30 initial clients incl. CHM, Mamoudzou town hall, Departmental Council, SIM and Tetrama. Proved resilient during Cyclone Chido (Dec 2024); interior undamaged, operations continued.
